title: The Grunion Run, 2008 · after
logline: The Monday after the first signing: Wood at the drafting table practicing a signature on scrap — the name, the mark — and hating each one, and the dog watching the pile of scrap grow. He settles on the one he already had.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at the table with a pile of scrap paper, signing and crossing out. BARNABY watching.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man at a drafting table signing scraps of paper and crossing them out with a dog watching

panels.composition: The scraps, close: the same name eight ways, all crossed out.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close on scraps of paper bearing the same signature eight ways each crossed out
